access.note: Drive-up summit reached by forest road and described as a popular drive-to lookout. Access is limited to summer and possibly early fall.

visit.trail_note: Deadwood Reservoir Road, then a little over 4 miles on Forest Road 555; 4WD or AWD recommended.

Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: wooden 20x20 structure with concrete foundation, garage and outbuildings.
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register on September 24, 2011.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources agree the current L-4 cab dates to 1934. The 1920 date belongs to the 12x12 log cabin that stood on the summit before it, so the two dates describe different structures and are not a real disagreement.
NHLR describes a 28x28 stone foundation/catwalk. The 1959 Coast and Geodetic Survey description, reproduced on the Forest Lookouts site, says concrete. The story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Build dates agree (1920 cabin, 1934 L-4 cab), so the brief's warning about conflicting build years does not apply to this cab. Open questions: the foundation material (stone vs concrete) and current staffing, since every staffing source is undated. Brief access 'unknown' is now described as drive-up. No fire history and no rental listing appeared in the six pages read or the two searches run, so the story does not mention either. Budget used: 6 page reads, 2 searches.
